rules: Pure price/return/range expressions with no fundamental or CS_RANK leg still dominate cheap_screen failures (7 of 20 rejects, |t| 0.23-0.83) — this includes $high-$low range/vol ratios, not just $return stats. The one price-only accept was a 21-vs-126-day $return spread scaled by 126-day $return vol (3.18); favor that short-minus-long-over-long-vol spread shape over ad hoc products of unrelated price stats.

Fitness ceiling moved from 6.794 to 10.016 this round: the top 3 accepts were close's position in its own range scaled by its guarded 21-day close vol (10.016), RANK(|eps|/close) (8.430), and RANK(eps) minus RANK(3-day close return/close) (7.273). Push deeper into these three shapes and their niches before spending budget on low-yield territory.

$earnings_per_share is now the single strongest fundamental leg (4 of 9 accepts, fitness 2.86-8.43), ahead of roe/roa this round, having been freed by a past eviction. Expect its easy niches (eps vs price level, eps vs short volume/return deltas, eps vs dollar_volume) to saturate within a round or two.

RANK($accrual_gap) is a crossover magnet producing degenerate children: 3 rejects this round were crossover_not_a_fusion for sharing only the trivial 2-node RANK($accrual_gap) fragment with a parent (a bare +/- against one other simple rank). Fuse in a multi-node subtree from the other parent, not a single extra rank bolted on.

Re-normalizing a volume field inside a denominator already keyed on that field doesn't decorrelate: CS_RANK($dollar_volume) vs raw $dollar_volume in the same guarded ratio hit rho 0.981, and TS_MEAN/TS_SUM smoothing both legs of an existing RANK(fundamental)*RANK(dollar_volume)-style product hit rho 0.910-0.915. Vary the field or window family, not the wrapper.

For $book_per_share, a 63-day point change (TS_DELTA) is weak alone even normalized by close (cheap_screen |t| 0.84); the same window's dispersion (TS_STD) crossed with accrual_gap accepted at 2.963. Favor dispersion over point-change for this field.

A guarded denominator built from TS_STD($volume, 21) collides with the existing volume-z-score archive block regardless of the numerator (archive_subtree, 5 shared nodes). Use a different window or a $dollar_volume-based dispersion in that slot instead.

Swapping which aggregate (MEAN vs MIN/MAX) fills the same slot in a $close/$low/$high range-position formula doesn't decorrelate (rho 0.984) — vary which fields occupy the slots, not which TS_ aggregate summarizes one of them.
